VERSION.value: github.com/rlabbe/filterpy master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)

value.lineage: FilterPy (2014-, Labbe): reference implementations of the Kalman family (KF/EKF/UKF), particle filters, and other Bayesian filters, written for clarity alongside the book 'Kalman and Bayesian Filters in Python'; carries example systems (a noisy nonlinear plant) AND the estimators that recover their hidden state

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: Bayesian state estimation across the filter family

value.built_to: estimate the hidden state of a dynamical system from noisy measurements across the whole Bayesian-filter family -- linear (KF), nonlinear (EKF/UKF), and non-Gaussian (particle filter)
value.pressure: nonlinearity and non-Gaussian noise where the plain Kalman filter fails; hidden state that must be tracked through a noisy, possibly multimodal posterior
value.success_means: a state estimate that tracks truth with low error and calibrated uncertainty, even when the system is nonlinear or the posterior is multimodal

value.pressure: noisy observation, nonlinear dynamics, non-Gaussian / multimodal uncertainty, hidden state
value.failure_condition: a diverged filter (EKF linearisation error) or a degenerate particle set (all weight on one particle) loses the track entirely
